title: Department of Commerce Announces Definitive Agreement with SandboxAQ for a $500 Million CHIPS R&D Award to Accelerate Al-Driven Semiconductor Materials Discovery
summary: The Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Research & Development Office today announced the signing of a definitive agreement with SandboxAQ for a $500 million award under the CHIPS and Science Act.
author: Andrew Kim
title_norm: department of commerce announces definitive agreement with sandboxaq for a 500 million chips r d award to accelerate al driven semiconductor materials discovery
